weaveProgram.name: Diagnose the contract
weaveProgram.goal: Read the implementation, docstring, and focused tests. Explain the two case-normalization boundaries and propose the smallest repair. Do not edit.

weaveProgram.name: Approve repair scope
weaveProgram.question: Is the diagnosis narrow enough to proceed with the implementation?

weaveProgram.name: Repair and test
weaveProgram.goal: Implement the approved minimal repair and run the focused upstream test. Inspect the diff for unrelated changes.

weaveProgram.name: Verify the contract
weaveProgram.criteria: Configured extensions and filenames match case-insensitively; leading dots, None, and defaults retain their documented behavior; focused tests pass.

tasks.title: Repair Starlette header normalization and order

weaveProgram.name: Map header invariants
weaveProgram.goal: Inspect construction, lookup, mutation, and existing tests. Map where key normalization and insertion-order preservation are enforced. Do not edit.

weaveProgram.name: Design adversarial cases
weaveProgram.goal: Before editing, reason through mixed-case mapping keys and non-adjacent duplicate raw headers. State the expected raw-list behavior.

weaveProgram.name: Implement the repair
weaveProgram.goal: Repair both invariants with a minimal change to datastructures.py and run the focused header tests. Do not modify tests.

weaveProgram.name: Verify invariants
weaveProgram.criteria: Mixed-case mapping keys normalize to lowercase bytes; duplicate assignment retains the first occurrence position and removes later duplicates; focused tests pass; only datastructures.py changed.

weaveProgram.name: Reproduce option identities
weaveProgram.goal: Inspect the option-name conversion and dual-option pairing code. Reproduce the failures with focused tests and identify both violated contracts. Do not edit.

weaveProgram.name: Approve contract
weaveProgram.question: Do the identified contracts match the existing test evidence?

weaveProgram.name: Repair option identity
weaveProgram.goal: Implement the smallest repair in lib/option.js and run both focused test files.

weaveProgram.name: Review compatibility
weaveProgram.goal: Review the diff against mixed-case option names and positive/negative duals. Correct any remaining issue and rerun focused tests.

weaveProgram.name: Verify option behavior
weaveProgram.criteria: Camelcase preserves existing character case after each dash; --feature and --no-feature share the feature attribute; focused tests pass; only option.js changed.
